title: Attio
description: Calm product-CRM light: a white page inside two hairlines, near-black text with slate-grey second clauses, #fafafa and #f2f3f4 panels, a near-black button, one blue for badges and rules, a lavender glow. A #111 pinstriped dark band for the middle, the CTA and the footer. Inter with its display optical size, a sturdy text serif for quotes.
notes: light is the faithful mode: the attio dark bands, CTA and footer force themselves dark with the dark class
Inter Variable from its opsz file so headings get the display cut; Newsreader stands in for Tiempos Text (closed) via --attio-serif; Source Code Pro for JetBrains Mono
--page-gutter and --section-y are clamps: 16px / 88px on phones, 24px / 152px on desktop
